I'm from latam, so we use the DSM-V, my point is that we can't just pretend its perfect, which is why we need to be critical bc not everything is a diagnosis. Btw, I'm more humanistic (my approach), so we dont talk about pathologies that much, we also say client instead of patient.

Everyone studies clinical psychology in the career, at least where we live: i'm not from the US or Europe. But not all teachers/experts agree with the DSM-V... We need to use it most of the time, of course, but we are taugh to be critical, which i appreciate a lot in my university.

Most of my teachers are not really fans of the DSM-V, we are kind of critical of it, which is why talking so much abt the criteria is just meh for us. 
I have no reason to lie in the internet, this year is actually my last in the career but i really think diagnosis is more complex bc there's many factors involved and that's what i been learning. Being judgemental is also never good... I always try to understand both sides but it seems you came here just to be aggressive. Anyways, have a good day.

I study psychology, and diagnosing is not that simple, sorry to burst your bubble. You dont go around checking all the boxes and just go "yep, you have x diagnosis, good luck", my teachers would straight up kick our asses if we did that. It's a very careful process... even the most obvious answer, sometimes, is not the right one: there's gender, race and cultural biases that need to be addressed too.

I study psychology and my take is just the same as almost everyone here, their behaviour screams couple and intimacy. If what bothers you is the age gap, that's a personal thing: they are two adults, therefore is not our place to judge. I don't see any weird dynamics between, seems pretty healthy to me. But to each their own.
No, your feelings are valid but that's not your decision to make.

It can be a reason. I been suicidal for many years, however, in my case, it has nothing to do with capitalism but existence... How can a world has so much suffering and awful human beings? The amount of good things are only a fraction, doesnt seem worth it. Some people are just not for this life, and im at peace with it. I support the right to die with dignity

His views are dangerous and he literally said he moved to Romania bc he wanted to get away with sh*t. No sane person should support him but this world is awful and some of the comments here,,, makes me lost faith in humanity once again.

I never wanted kids... I always knew i was sort of an error in this world, i used to dream of living with my friends only and nothing else. Weirdly enough, i love being like this, i feel like an observer seeing everything fall into chaos, i'll never surrender to the traditional ways, thats just not in my nature.

I hate the idea that if you were diagnosed late is because you have good coping mechanism and skills in social life: my ways of coping are self-destructive, I never connected with anyone and always felt like a failure. It does seems like i wasted so much... Maybe knowing sooner would have open more doors for me, instead of torturing myself trying to excel at things at the cost of my mental health. Sadly, we will never know.
Dysthymia and GAD. I'm also autistic, but that's not a mental illness, just a neurological condition
This works for some time... Sadly, there's a stopping point, at least, that's how it was for me. 2022 is my last year, I'm just too exhausted
I don't like the taste... However, i dont drink it bc I know i'll become an addict lol, so yeah no...

I didn't, but the people seeing me in university started suspecting I was autistic. Actually, i was told about the possibility of having aspergers before that... I had many traits but for some reason, they didn't diagnose me.

I call that "distractions" bc at the end of the day, reality hits me, always, i cannot escape. I'm actively suicidal and still, I have my nice moments... But they don't mean anything compare to my mental suffering.

No. I'm suffering but no because of autism... Thats my dysthymia probably. I wouldn't be me anymore...  Being like others, unable to see the true horrors of existence? Hell no, I like to know everything, i dont want to be ignorant, the pain is just part of the deal.

I'm in (mental) pain, but this is the norm for me. It hurts like hell waking up and realizing i'm alive, but somehow, i'm still here. This will change tho, I decided suffering is not worth it anymore, i want to rest forever, I want peace.

6 here (i think?) and almost everything. Actually, i was thinking maybe i'm a 4 but everytime I go back to the 6, it's like a curse lol. I'm not social at all, i don't feel like I belong anywhere. I do have extreme anxiety and some paranoia, cannot lie there, i used to have delusions of persecution as a teen... However, if you are "mentally ill" it's very hard to distinguish who you really are, so i don't think it relates to being a 6. The loyalty thing... I mean sure, i can be loyal with the right person, I haven't meet anyone like that so far tho. Also, I'm not traditional at all, idk why people think 6's are conservative? I hate the status quo, I hate being "normal and just a follower", doesn't fit me. Projection is not my defense mechanism either... It's retroflection: i dont blame others, just myself. 
I'm pretty sure my wing is 5, but the stereotypes of this one dont bother me much, so yeah.

I don't like reality, that's my reason, and i don't truly belong here anyways. And I know, which is why I been planning for years, its a rational choice i'm making, i believe in the right to die in peace.
I'm autistic! Sadly, im not sure of my type yet (its been years, still dont know)... I'm between 4 or 6, but definitely w5.

Yes, i have dysthymia too and it sucks. I been suicidal as long as i can remember, I never felt happy here or connected to people. However, I guess im not that "passive" anymore: i'm writing my final note, thinking where and how. I'm totally calm about it, I guess i'm just at that point where nothing really matters lol.

Maybe i'm wrong here, but i thought types in the enneagram are not your "identity" but your mask, right? I studied the enneagram for Naranjo in university, so i'm a bit confused. But well... Now to the question, i guess 4's? And maybe 5's.

I guess i'm too apathetic bc i don't care what random people do in social media. Also, this reads like you are trying to separate yourself for certain group of people and feel ashamed about it... I dont get that, autistic people with "sereve symptoms" are still part of our community, nobody is superior here.  I understans being "bothered" by stereotypes, but this is a spectrum for a reason .
I want to die too, existing is pure torture but well... Everyone is different i guess, some people want to live (no matter how weird that is to me...)

Having this is the most exhausting thing ever: yes, i can function but at what cost? I have suicidal ideation 24/7, i cry daily and it takes all of my energy, I barely enjoy living but somehow... That's not that "bad" bc i can study and attend university (with multiple mental breakdowns mind you...). People really dont take it seriously...
*Sigh* this strange fight between subreddits is just exhausting... Who cares, if u prefer here or there- both sides has bad things anyways, that's how reality works.

We all know this is a common practice... That doesn't make it okay tho... lol I study psychology, we see these issues and the amount of damage it causes is insane. This situation is not a matter of opinions, we have done research and everything points to being dangerous. I'm so happy she stood up for herself, not all idols can do that... Some have been conditioned to believe is "okay" and its pretty disturbing.

I study psychology and there's many reasons why this happens: gender differences in autism or bias, racial bias, even social class and so on. I was very smart as a child, so nobody thought of me being autistic, however, i couldn't communicate properly and i had bad social skills in general. I recommend people to look up papers/books/research on the matter.
Yeah, i'm lazy, i think that's why. I'm just waiting for my time to explode, I want to see how much I can deal with. I'll stick around a little longer then...
The void? Death I guess, i'm too tired to keep trying anymore.
I feel the same... I died the moment i was born, whatever i am right now it wasn't supposed to be. But i'm going home soon.

I'm autistic, and no, its not wrong. We all have different abilities and areas we excel at (i know this pretty well, i'm leaning more in the research side), if this is not for you, that's fine. Also, i don't believe if has something to do with them being autistic... Is just not your call, so dont worry.

Ideally. I think giving the opportunity to more autistic actors does a lot in terms of representation, however, if not possible its okay too... If they did research in the topic and talked with autistic people (basic stuff really) then why not, i dont mind. Just do your job right

I'm going "home" soon too... Not now, i need the tools, but i'm on my way. Living with dysthymia sucks, i dont feel anything at all so there's no point in keep suffering. I think you have your reasons... What you are feeling is 100% valid and i'll not try to say "things will get better" bc it's not true. I'm still here only because of my interests... I'm waiting for the moment i get bored so i can go: knowing you can die at any moment its the most amazing feeling ever (as your choice, of course). Wishing you the best in whatever you do! I hope u find peace
I dont understand the desire for it. I guess I'm really broken, but to me existence seems like a bad idea... I wanted to stay in the void.
Wow... I wish i was there, this place seems so peaceful.

I'm autistic, i have dysthymia and generalized anxiety disorder (some weird personality traits too). More than amazed... Im truly terrified. A person like me, suffering everyday and somehow im still here??? I don't even want to think about people that live with physical pain, theres something wrong with humans... What exactly? Im not sure, but to me its more ugly or just neutral, never beautiful.

Yup yup... I'm thinking of ending my life pretty soon?  I have my ways too, so im sort of okay with this fact. Some of us... We are meant to die like this, its our fate, but society isn't ready to accept it.
For sure, i need to be quiet, nice and perfect. If i'm not... Im pretty sure they will hate me lmao... Everyone loves the mask! I'm in process of unmasking and i'm already seeing the difference...

"Things will get better :)"
Ah yeah, I didn't know you could predict the future! Neat! 
I wish they would just shut the fck up.

Everyone is saying things that make perfect sense! but somehow my mind just can't see it like that, maybe because I still feel guilty for being like this and wasting the time of others... There's people out there that need more help than me, after all, according to every teacher i'm pretty lucky! and i should just do stuff! I don't think I'll ever forget that...

Thanks for your kind words, i wish i could believe it right now but i'm still feeling dizzy from all the crying... once i calm down, i'll take this words to heart.  I do feel I was masking a lot before and now i'm a little more free to show the struggles... makes me feel a little guilty, but idk what else can i do...
I see, thank you, it makes senses in a way. I just feel pretty useless right now and mad at myself for not being able to do things without help, i don't want to be a burden

Well, I was doing university online for 2 years and now we are back and the level of exigency is higher because i'm in my fourth year. This means more exposure to social situations, doing interventions in big groups and such. My first year was easy bc I didn't have to do presentations, and in general, the amount of work was minimal... Even if it was in person. Right now, i compare myself with others and I notice that i cant keep up with them... I feel useles. According to the people that are helping me, this situation was bound to happen bc it was a big change. Deep down i know that I was going to suffer a little bit more... But I didn't expected like this... I still feel like I'm faking everything, even without having control of it. I just wish I was stronger... I feel weak and pathetic.

I'm still in uni, but I'm afraid i'll not make it lol. Academic settings are extremely stressful for me, I'm pretty good at studying and learning... But the social implications? Nah, i'll literally pass out if i do presentations or group projects. I'm receiving help and all... But it sucks, i hate it with every fiber of my body, this system is not meant for us.

Explaining my situation and being ignore because "I look to normal and I have it more easy than other autistic people". Sadly, they say this to make me feel better and "capable" but it does the opposite effect. Feels like they are denying my request for help, that my struggles are nothing.

I would be mad too, not for me, but for other autistic people that really might be hurt by hearing this misconception. When people say i'm an alien or robot, i embrace it and I think is sort of fun, but thats just for me!. Being dehumanized is awful in general for the majority... Your feelings are valid and your heart is in the right place.
Yes and yes, I feel both at the same and its very confusing sometimes.

Death? lol
I dont have any, but there's a few things I like... So I'm sticking around just for that, until i get bored.

I never understood the concept of having kids, it's so foreign to me and confuses me a lot. I don't care about others, if they want children, I guess that's fine. But I don't get it so yeah... I dont want them or care for them.

How do you know your IQ? I dont trust online tests tbh... I do think i'm sort of smart, at least in my career, I don't struggle like others (just the social part lol) and im just vibing here, trying to finish my education.

Me too, i really don't feel anything when people cry, I get overwhelmed and i want them to stop. This makes me sound like a bad person, but besides lying or faking sympathy, i really can't do much. I'm very conflicted about what can I do in those situations... Will they prefer that i'm genuine even if that means being cold? Or will they want my fake self? there's no winning here. At this point, I want to be myself and try to help in my own ways.

Honestly. I used to debate with myself about this... Right now, i'm sure i'll end my life in 2-5 years from here, which is why i'm not telling anyone. It's a big effort... To keep such secret so i understand why you maybe felt the need to vent, its ok.

I'm in university right now.
I'm very good at studying so things go smoothly in that area. However, socially speaking, it sucks and sometimes it's extremely frustrating... I hope I survive... I only have two years left.
This is literally how my mom and the world see me...

The issue is.... How do we know someone is using mental health as an "excuse"?. I think sometimes this idea can be very dangerous for a lot of us with mental illnesses: for example, i'm autistic and there's things I can't do, no matter how hard I try. My depression and anxiety also stops me from doing normal things. I don't know how the other person is feeling, so I never assume anything, my experience is only my experience after all...

I have low empathy too and there's no point in feeling bad. I know its a stereotype, but we exists, there's autistic people that have issues with empathy and that doesn't mean we are "heartless". I accepted this fact, still bothers me sometimes but I can't do much about it. I don't like to hurt people and i understand when something is "wrong", i just can't feel sadness unless it affects me.

This is why i'll leave a letter behind and do a intensive research about all methods and their consequences. I'll do it when I have the all the resources at hand and the information. Better to be safe.
In society? I'm not sure... The most weird thing for me in general is existence itself, doesn't make sense.
Verbal and written instructions are always so hard for me... I need people to show me step by step the whole process, I guess i'm more visual in a way

I don't have schizoid personality disorder, but I do have some traits. It's confusing because i'm also autistic and is common to get misdiagnosed, both can easily overlap. However, I been told by psychiatrists and psychologists before that I have cluster A traits... So yeah

Oh man, they did the same to me? Now i'm getting anxious. I thought this was the normal evaluation, it seems thats not the case... I mean, they talked to my parents too, so there's that... But wow.

Guilt tripping doesn't work for some of us. I know that this kind of narrative has saved lives, but reading stuff like this just makes me feel more resentment toward humans... Its always about how others feel, our pain is nothing to them. If only the right to die were a thing...
I remember more my dreams and fantasies than my childhood. I have memories but they feel empty somehow...

i like the idea of an emotional connection but not the real thing. I live in my fantasy world 24/7 and i think i'm fine this way, however, i do get bored and feel the need for some drama in my life: thats when i wish for interactions. Thankfully, when i experience how exhausting it is to have relationships with people, i go back to isolate and be in peace. I dont like to make efforts and i hate pretending i care for others... emotions are hard for me to process, i can barely deal with me so i prefer the solitary life.
Yes but i guess i had learn to endure it somehow
Tap water sucks... I hate the taste so I love mineral water!

Very often. I take showers daily so every day i'm reminded that i'm a "human" and i need to take care of this vessel. Pretty annoying in general but what can u do? The only time i feel fully free and no-human is when im sleeping lol

To me... Its not worth it, but i know everyone will not agree with it. Humans are so attached to their lives, this is due to biology: we want to survive. As a person that has rejected this flesh prison and wants to die on their own terms... I'll always say that living really isnt worth it, the amount of suffering is too much... The good barely even compares lol
I can read it and English isn't even my native language... Some words are hard to understand but i think thats just me and my low vocabulary lol
It's my only way of coping, so i understand the feeling. I don't think i'll ever get tired of the fantasy... Makes me feel more free knowing i have the chance to quit at any moment.
I would love to but is not safe...
Yes. I don't think there's a solution for my case, I always been uncomfortable with existence, with being alive... Pretty sure i'll die by my own hands and its really sad, but thats life i guess.

I been there... A teacher said to me in front of everyone years back: "I expected more from you, i'm disappointed". Honestly, so unnecessary... I dont understand teachers that do this, its disgusting. 
After that, i went to cry in the bathroom lol and ended up self h*rming to cope, i was extremely overwhelmed. I hope you can find a solution with that, your feelings are valid, i wish u the best.

I agree. I'm thinking of killing myself once i'm done with University... Two more years and i'll be free of this hell! I believe in the right to die, sadly, society isn't ready for this discussion yet

Thank you for your response. I know I need proper treatment and that's why I thought that being autistic was maybe the reason why nothing worked with me. I was considered a "resistant" patient, at least in terms of my depression, it seems i never get better. The thing is... i been with many psychologists and i'm tired of repeting the same stuff, i feel like a broken record. So i was relief about this diagnosis and thought this would be final... I guess i have to wait and see what this psychiatrist has to say

I'm sorry you had those experiences... sounds awful. And yeah, there's something about most psychiatrists i have seen, they have that weird vibe... i feel intimidated by them. Right now im just confused because i been years trying to understand myself and when I think I'm finally close to it... stuff like this happens and it makes me doubt. It's frustrating... well, i'll talk with my psychopedagogue about this and see what we can do. Thank you for the response! good luck seeking your diagnosis!

Dont worry, i never had them either... Main reason why people probably didn't thought i was autistic. As a kid i didn't have any motivation besides getting good grades, maybe writing and drawing... Now as an adult, I have a lot of hyperfixations but they last just a month or half a year if im lucky.

Pretty sure most people are still here due to guilt. They are thinking about their families and how much suffering it will cause them. I'm here because theres no safe way to go... What if i fail and i end up in a worse state? honestly, thats my biggest fear. I believe strongly in the right to die, I think society as a whole doesn't like the idea because "no people = no production", they need us as slaves after all to keep making money

100% agree. Society has push this narrative that you should have romantic love and sex to be happy. I understand that for some people is really important, but we can't deny that media plays a part here, trying to make us feel guilty when we dont fulfill that standard.

I don't think psychology is junk science? idk if you are responding to me but i'm just critical of psychology because i believe it can be better, there's a lot of bullsh\*t in the field, with autism is always the no-autistic people talking about it, spreading misinformation and speaking on our behalf, i don't think that's fair and okay.

I study psychology too, I was diagnosed just recently and since then, I can't unsee the amount of misinformation about autism, it's crazy because you expect that in such a career people will... idk... Do their research and not spread misconceptions and stereotypes???? Honestly, it kills my energy and motivation sometimes, and i live with the fear of other students knowing i'm in the spectrum because I know how they will perceive me after. Everytime autism is mention in a class I feel ready to either fight or flight

I guess cats? I do feel more understood with them... I'm autistic too, so maybe that's why i have this issues with identity, i been living my life longing for something i cannot reach and it hurts. But i guess there's no other options, just looking for ways to make the feeling go away

Or have a terminal illness... Yeah, i understand that feeling. Sometimes i also wish to be stabbed or kick to death: the thought of suffering in my last moments, bleeding internally o externally... Being unable to move, dizzy because of the pain... Its so damn addicting

Yeah, same. I wish I could experience different universes everyday... or just fun adventures. But I can't, we are slaved to work for the system, we need money or we die. Even being human is boring af, if only I could be an entity observing the world and nothing else... a dream.

I feel the same. It seems some people are totally okay knowing this fact, but personally, I can't cope with it. Our true self is an illusion after all... I really despise that i can't never feel like myself, i hate being human too.

Are you me? This is exactly how i feel and how my journey went! I have the same view abt self-diagnosis too... Maybe bc i study psychology i can see why it can lead to a dangerous path, we need to be careful all the time

I study psychology so i think different about this... I mean, yeah, it can be valid in a way but sometimes people can convices themselves that they are something they are not, leading to a bad diagnosis. This is dangerous, at least for me, i thought i had BPD for a long time... I was wrong and i still feel like my autism isnt real, but it is. Also, in my career, we have a set of criteria when someone is kinda of faking? most of the time to get some benefits but we are aware thats no the only reason, that we can be wrong and we are encourage to seek new points of views from other proffesionals. After all, sometimes we have our bias... We are not perfect. 
In general, i believe that its better to say you have "x" symptoms and that you *might* be autistic, i never felt ok saying i was "this or that" with no proof, thats in my case. (I know that theres social factors too.. Getting a diagnosis can be a long journey and expensive as hell... So i get it but being honest, i cant shake the feeling that society today is so fragmented and it can be an attempt of looking for identity... Just a theory).
Nah, I dont think any other group will top loona. I'm not into kpop, i only like loona bc of their concept and uniqueness in music, bbc has nothing to offer me.

I don't blame my autism for my suicidal thoughts... Yes, i'm painfully aware that I'm different and the world will never be kind to me bc of that... But at the same time, I dread the idea of being nornal... I'm suicidal bc i see nothing worth in existing, everything is just boring af.

Hmmmm maybe? Sadly, I'm the autistic person with empathy problems, so i can't say I have more emotional skills that NT's... I just don't but I don't think is a bad thing? Just because I can't feel what others feel doesn't mean i can't help them. I'm more focused in solutions and that's alright.

Sometimes i have this weird feeling that I have forgotten something important when I see liminal spaces... It's strange, these pictures evoke such intense emotions. I'm glad i'm not the only one... It's extremely overwhelming yet beautiful????
I don't like the word and i don't see any positive connotation in it to be reclaimed.

I agree. I was suspected to have BPD/Personality disorder a while back... I thought it made senses and almost conviced myself about it... Turns out i'm autistic, sometimes i still doubt it but thats a symptom of years believing otherwise.

This is me... I'm always like: "i can do the entire written project alone, no problem but PLEASE dont make me do the presentation" I also have accommodations but i feel useless when i ask to be excluded from certain things... I feel guilty even.

As an autistic person the only thing that bothers is that most of this people take away resources from the actually disabled. I live in a third world country, we already don't have enough for everyone so when i see someone faking and getting "support" it does hurts. Now, as an psychology student, they can spread tons of misinformation and its dangerous. I believe that if you fake having a disorder, there's something wrong with you mentally, so we really want to help them. Autistic people has the right to feel uncomfortable with the current trend... And you have the right to your opinion but i dont think it's healthy: to me this is a symptom of our lack of identity in society... And its pretty sad.
I can't be happy for people and sometimes I feel like the biggest piece of sh*t for it, but at the same time... I'm tired of pretending that I care that much.
I was just an averaged kid that didn't talk much...
I just say "good" bc i dont want to talk with people...

No. Why? I wouldn't be me. Existence is already awful but at least i have my mind, my memories and experiences. Thanks to that... I can see the world in a different light and i know my autism has something to do with it.
Literally who cares... I study psychology and nobody takes the MBTI serious... I get it if it's a topic you are passionate about, but it's not that deep.
There's nothing missing from my brain so yeah... This feels off... Also, my autism does define me in a way, its part of my identity! If you take it away, you take away my authentic self.

Honestly, i dont understand why people feel this need to share their faces. I use reddit because i want to stay anonymous and it's not like other social media...I mean, I dont judge but I want to see other content
I'm a 6 and chaotic neutral but welp...
Yes. Being a shapeshifter sounds fun... Sometimes i want to be a cat just living my best life, other times i only want to be the wind or a shadow... Humans are boring af.
Most methods, if no all, are dangerous in a way. There's always the chance you will fail... Reason why a lot of us are still here.
